github.host.rejected.credentials.defaultMessage: A GitHub host can’t hold a user name, password or token.
github.host.rejected.credentials.description: An error saving a GitHub host setting (HI-2779): it has an @ (user name, password or token before the host). Combwork never stores credentials there.

github.host.rejected.empty.defaultMessage: Enter a host name, such as github.com or yourcompany.ghe.com.
github.host.rejected.empty.description: An error saving a GitHub host setting (HI-2779): the host is empty. Keep the example host names.

github.host.rejected.invalid.defaultMessage: That isn’t a host name, such as github.com or yourcompany.ghe.com.
github.host.rejected.invalid.description: An error saving a GitHub host setting (HI-2779): the text isn’t a valid host name. Keep the example host names.

github.host.rejected.notCloud.defaultMessage: Copilot signs in on github.com or a GHE.com host (yourcompany.ghe.com). For your own GitHub Enterprise Server, choose its Copilot proxy instead.
github.host.rejected.notCloud.description: An error saving where Copilot signs in (HI-2779): the host given is a GitHub Enterprise Server host, where cloud Copilot can’t sign in. GHE.com is GitHub’s product name; Copilot proxy: GitHub Enterprise Server’s preview. Keep the host names.

github.host.rejected.path.defaultMessage: A GitHub host is only its name, without a path after it.
github.host.rejected.path.description: An error saving a GitHub host setting (HI-2779): it has a path after the host name (/org/repo).

github.host.rejected.port.defaultMessage: A GitHub host is only its name, without a port.
github.host.rejected.port.description: An error saving a GitHub host setting (HI-2779): it has :port after the host name.

github.host.rejected.query.defaultMessage: A GitHub host is only its name, without ? or # after it.
github.host.rejected.query.description: An error saving a GitHub host setting (HI-2779): it has a query string or fragment. Keep ? and #.

github.host.rejected.scheme.defaultMessage: A GitHub host is a name such as github.com, or an https:// address: no other scheme.
github.host.rejected.scheme.description: An error saving a GitHub host setting (HI-2779): it starts with a scheme other than https:// (http://, ssh://…). Keep github.com and https:// as they are.

github.host.restart.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# running agent signed in on another GitHub host than its project uses now. Restart it to apply the change.} other {# running agents signed in on another GitHub host than their projects use now. Restart them to apply the change.}}
github.host.restart.description: A notification (HI-2779) after a GitHub host setting changed: how many running agents ({n}) launched signed in on another GitHub host than the setting now gives; the change applies when each restarts.

github.host.restartTitle.description: A notification’s title (HI-2779): a workspace’s or project’s GitHub host setting changed.

github.hosts.choose.defaultMessage: {host} is a GitHub Enterprise Server: choose where Copilot signs in. Copilot agents don’t start until you do.
github.hosts.choose.description: Under “Copilot signs in on” (HI-2779): the repositories are on a GitHub Enterprise Server host ({host}), where cloud Copilot can’t sign in, and nothing is chosen.

github.hosts.copilot.description: A setting (HI-2779): the GitHub host GitHub Copilot signs in on, which can differ from the repositories’ host.

github.hosts.copilotDesc.defaultMessage: Usually the same as the GitHub host. With repositories on GitHub Enterprise Server, choose where your Copilot licence is: github.com or your GHE.com host.
github.hosts.copilotDesc.description: What the setting “Copilot signs in on” is for (HI-2779). GHE.com is GitHub’s product name.

github.hosts.desc.defaultMessage: Where the repositories are, and where Copilot signs in. Saved as you change them; running Copilot agents use a change when they restart.
github.hosts.desc.description: Under the heading “GitHub” (HI-2779): what its two settings are, and that they save at once and apply at an agent’s restart.

github.hosts.fromEnvironment.description: Where a GitHub host comes from (HI-2779): environment variables Combwork was started with. Keep the variable names.

github.hosts.heading.description: A heading in the Version Control tab and in Settings → Version Control → Workspace defaults (HI-2779): the GitHub host settings. GitHub is a product name.

github.hosts.host.description: A setting (HI-2779): the host of the repositories: github.com, a GHE.com host (yourcompany.ghe.com) or a GitHub Enterprise Server.

github.hosts.hostDesc.defaultMessage: github.com, your GHE.com host (yourcompany.ghe.com) or your GitHub Enterprise Server’s name. Only the name: no path, port or token.
github.hosts.hostDesc.description: What the setting “GitHub host” takes (HI-2779). GHE.com is GitHub’s product name; keep the host names.

github.hosts.inherit.description: A button beside a GitHub setting set at this level (HI-2779): stop setting it here and use the inherited value.

github.hosts.inheritOption.description: An option of “Copilot signs in on” (HI-2779): use the inherited choice. {value} is what that gives (a host, or a note).

github.hosts.kind.gheCloud.defaultMessage: GitHub Enterprise Cloud with data residency
github.hosts.kind.gheCloud.description: The kind of a GitHub host (HI-2779): a GHE.com host (GitHub product name).

github.hosts.kind.ghes.description: The kind of a GitHub host (HI-2779): a company’s own GitHub Enterprise Server (GitHub product name).

github.hosts.kind.github.description: The kind of a GitHub host (HI-2779): github.com itself.

github.hosts.noneChosen.description: In the option “Inherit (…)” of “Copilot signs in on” (HI-2779): what inheriting gives when the repositories are on GitHub Enterprise Server and nothing is chosen above (lower case, inside brackets).

github.hosts.otherOption.description: An option of “Copilot signs in on” (HI-2779): a host of GitHub Enterprise Cloud with data residency (yourcompany.ghe.com), typed in. GHE.com is GitHub’s product name.

github.hosts.proxy.defaultMessage: Not supported yet: Copilot agents don’t start. Choose github.com or your GHE.com host.
github.hosts.proxy.description: Under “Copilot signs in on” (HI-2779) when GitHub Enterprise Server’s Copilot proxy is chosen. GHE.com is GitHub’s product name.

github.hosts.proxyOption.defaultMessage: GitHub Enterprise Server’s Copilot proxy (not supported yet)
github.hosts.proxyOption.description: An option of “Copilot signs in on” (HI-2779): GitHub Enterprise Server’s Copilot proxy, a GitHub preview Combwork doesn’t support yet.

github.hosts.sameOption.description: An option of “Copilot signs in on” (HI-2779): Copilot signs in on the repositories’ host.

github.hosts.saveFailed.description: An error’s title (HI-2779): a GitHub host setting couldn’t be saved (its message says why).
